metadata.description: Study Desk: six study skills for Claude (flashcards, quiz, grading, explanation, revision plan, mock exam), every item tied to the student's own material.

plugins.name: study-desk
plugins.description: Learn material you already have, honestly: flashcards, practice questions and mock exams drawn only from your notes, slides or textbook, each tied to its passage; grading that says what was right, missing and wrong; explanations in the material's own terms; a revision plan to your exam date.
